run_fast_tests: run the StableDiffusionImageVariationPipelineFastTests to test image variation with dummy components on CPU
run_slow_tests: run the StableDiffusionImageVariationPipelineSlowTests to test the pipeline with pretrained models on GPU
run_nightly_tests: run the StableDiffusionImageVariationPipelineNightlyTests to test PNDM and DPM schedulers with full inference steps
test_image_variation_default: test the StableDiffusionImageVariationPipeline default case with dummy inputs and verify output image shape
test_sequential_cpu_offloading: test the StableDiffusionImageVariationPipeline with sequential CPU offloading to verify memory usage under 2.6 GB
